Redesign two Nxeon marketing landing pages that are used as Google Ads destinations, to be conversion-friendly and consistent with the site's best pages. Work ONLY in `/opt/nxeon-wt-landers` (branch feature/landing-redesign). Edit `app/(marketing)/vps/page.tsx` and `app/(marketing)/web-hosting/page.tsx`. Commit + push when done. Do NOT run `npm run build`/`prisma` — write code and run `npx tsc --noEmit`.

## HARD RULE from the owner: DO NOT STRIP ANY CONTENT
Keep EVERY headline, every stat/number (including "99.9% Uptime SLA", "47s"/deploy-time figures, uptime %, any "from $X" price), every feature bullet, every section, and all existing copy — VERBATIM. This is a DESIGN-ONLY redesign. You may re-order, re-group, and re-style sections and restructure the layout for conversion, but you must not delete or reword the marketing claims. If a claim currently exists, it must still exist after your redesign. (The owner is aware of the claims and has explicitly chosen to keep them.)

## Goal: match the gold standard + convert better
The site's two best pages are the GOLD STANDARD: the homepage `app/page.tsx` and the pricing page `app/(marketing)/pricing/page.tsx` + `components/marketing/PricingExplorer.tsx`. Read them first. Bring `/vps` and `/web-hosting` up to that same premium look and the same reusable system:
- Real theme: navy/violet/cyan, glass. Geist font is already loaded globally — don't touch fonts.
- Reuse the shared primitives instead of one-off markup: `components/marketing/primitives.tsx` (`PageHero`, `Section`, `SectionTitle`, `Eyebrow`), `components/marketing/sections.tsx` (`SectionHeading`, `FeatureCard`, `CtaBand`, `TrustBadges`), and the CSS utilities `.card`/`.card-hover`/`.lift`, `grad-text`, `.eyebrow(-pill)`, `hero-aura`, `tone-panel/deep/light`, `.btn-primary/.btn-secondary`, plus `AmbientField` + `Reveal`. Also `ReviewBadges` for social proof (as the homepage uses it).

## Specific known issues to fix (from an audit)
- **`/web-hosting`** is built off-template: it hand-rolls cards as `rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-navy-850/60 p-6` — replace with `className="card"` (correct surface/blur/shadow). Its `Reveal` uses `delay={0.05}` / `delay={i*0.05}` — `delay` is in **milliseconds**, so no stagger renders; use `delay={i*60}` like the gold standard. It uses `Section size="md"` where product pages use `size="lg"`, and `SectionTitle` with no `eyebrow` — add eyebrows and use `size="lg"`. Any "featured/popular" tier should use the site's `.card lift … glow-brand` pattern (see business-email / block-storage pages).
- **`/vps`** — restructure into a proper conversion lander (see structure below); keep all its stats/copy.

## Conversion structure (both pages) — for paid-search landing pages
1. **Above the fold**: a strong `PageHero` — the existing headline, a clear **"from $X/mo"** price anchor (VPS from the real Starter price; hosting from its real cheapest plan — pull from the same DB source the pricing/other pages use, no hard-coded numbers), a primary CTA (`.btn-primary` → the same signup/deploy href the current pages/CTAs use), a secondary "See plans" link, and a trust row (`ReviewBadges` or `TrustBadges`: no lock-in, cancel anytime, DDoS, NVMe). Keep the existing hero visual/screen if there is one.
2. **Plan/price section** high up: real DB-fed plan cards (mirror how the pricing page renders them; keep displayed===charged) with the popular tier anchored — so price + CTA are visible early.
3. Then the existing feature/benefit sections (restyled with `FeatureCard`/`Section`), the existing stats (kept, just styled as a clean stat band), social proof, existing FAQ if present, and a closing `CtaBand`.
4. Mobile-first and fast.

## Honesty/consistency guardrails (still apply)
- Any price you render must be DB-fed and equal what checkout charges (reuse existing helpers/queries; no hard-coded plan prices). First-month-free is HOSTING-ONLY — it may appear on `/web-hosting` (that page's real offer) but NEVER add a free-month/$0 cue to `/vps`.
- Keep existing copy/claims exactly (per the hard rule above) — do NOT add NEW invented stats either; just restyle what's there.
- No amber except semantic. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` (motion-safe only).

## Output
- Both pages compile (`npx tsc --noEmit` clean — report result). Keep each page's `metadata`/SEO exports.
- Commit + push to `origin/feature/landing-redesign`.
- Report: the new section order for each page, which primitives/components you adopted, confirmation that all original copy/stats were preserved (list the claims you kept), and that prices are DB-fed + first-month-free stays hosting-only. This previews on staging before going live — make them genuinely premium and conversion-focused.

Done. `/game-servers` brought to the same standard, committed and pushed to `origin/feature/landing-redesign` (`d4b432c..f02111d`).

## New hero structure (`app/(marketing)/game-servers/page.tsx`)
The whole page is now wrapped in the `AmbientField` dot-field + soft radial aura (same depth treatment as `/vps` and `/web-hosting`). Inside the existing `PageHero` (headline "Game servers that just work", sub, and both CTAs — "Get started" → `/register`, "See pricing" → `#pricing` — all kept verbatim), I added a children block:
1. **DB-fed price anchor** — `"Game servers from {money(fromCents)}/mo · cancel anytime"`, where `fromCents = Math.min(...gamePlans.map(p => p.priceCents))` reusing the page's existing `db.gamePlan` query and `money()` helper. Renders only when plans exist.
2. **`TrustBadges`** row — Instant deploy · DDoS protection · Full control panel · Cancel anytime (all claims already made on the page).
3. **`ReviewBadges`** — same social-proof component the other two landers now use.

## Guardrails confirmed
- **Design-only, copy kept verbatim**: headline, sub, both CTAs, the Supported-games grid, `WHY` cards, control-panel showcase, per-game pricing tiers, the "Popular game servers" internal-link sections, and all indicative starting prices are unchanged.
- **Prices DB-fed**: the price anchor and the per-game tiers both read live from `db.gamePlan` (`priceCents`); displayed === charged. No hard-coded numbers introduced.
- **`GAME_META` hex gradients/logos untouched** — brand identity preserved.
- **Pricing reachable early**: the hero's secondary "See pricing" CTA jump-links straight to the `#pricing` per-game tiers, so price + Deploy land fast for paid-search traffic.
- No amber, no VAT work, motion-safe (StatCounter/Reveal already respect reduced-motion).
- `npx tsc --noEmit` → exit 0.

All three landers (`/vps`, `/web-hosting`, `/game-servers`) are now on the branch and consistent.
